description: storage: the three documented storage operations (createStorageStoresBlob, getStorageStoresById, deleteStorageStoresBlobById) omit the standard teamId/slug query parameters every other team-scoped operation declares. Team-scoped tokens infer the team, but the alchemy provider doctrine passes the resolved teamId on every call, so declare them.

value.description: The Team identifier to perform the request on behalf of.
value.name: teamId

value.description: The Team slug to perform the request on behalf of.
value.name: slug
